page.layout: One printed page, one column of text set in a narrow measure on the left; running head and page number at the top; a block of numerals as a heading-like list at the top; a table of Roman numerals with Arabic values in the middle; a table of thousands below; a short paragraph set into the text; no marginal notes.

main_text.l: Nam I circumscriptum media lunula à
dextro latere, valet quingenta. Ex cujus
notæ similitudine, litera, D, ab aliquibus
cIↄ, vel ꝏ, vel cXↄ, millia, 1000. Hinc
factū est, ut vulgò M. pro mille scriberetur.

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic in the heading lines; the numeral block at the top is a list of values. Several Roman-numeral thousands are written with the reversed-C form (cIↄ, IↃ) and are rendered as printed. The line "Ɔƍ." and "IↃↃↃ." are doubtful readings of the reversed-D and reversed-C numerals in the table; "cccIↄↄↄↄ" and "ccccIↄↄↄↄↄ" are reconstructed from the scan. Bottom of the page ends mid-word ("Quin-") with the catchword "V. Quin-" at the foot. Show-through and edge marks at the left margin are not transcribed.
